raw_sections.summary:
CAREER OBJECTIVE
Seeking a Network Engineering role where I can leverage my expertise in routing, switching, and
network security to deliver reliable solutions, while continuously enhancing my skills in advanced
networking technologies.
Summary:
Network Engineer with 4.5+ years of experience, specializing in computer networking and network security. Proven ability in troubleshooting, system support, and ensuring reliable network performance in enterprise environments.
AcademicQualifications: Completed Bsc from Dravidian University (Kuppam) in the year 2020 with Cgpa:7.96
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Routing Skills: - Static & Default Routing, RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, HSRP, Route Redistribution, Route
Filtering (ACL, Prefix-List, Route-Map), Policy-Based Routing (PBR), VRF, NAT/PAT, IPSec VPN, GRE tunnels, Load balancing & Path selection, Routing table troubleshooting (RIB/FIB).
Platforms Worked On: Cisco Catalyst Series (C9300, C9200, C9500, 6513, 3750, 2960), Cisco Nexus
9000 (9K), Cisco ISR Routers (4000/1000 Series).
Switching skills: -VLANs, Trunking, Inter-VLAN Routing, STP (PVST+, RSTP, MST), EtherChannel
(LACP/PAgP), Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, Port Security, DHCP Snooping, IP Source Guard, DAI, Loop prevention, Broadcast storm control, Switch stacking (Stack Wise), PortFast, BPDU Guard, LLDP/CDP, Network monitoring & troubleshooting.
Network and Security Knowledge: -
➢ Configuring and Managing Cisco Catalyst C9300, C9200, C9500, Nexus 9K, Cisco 6513 Catalyst
Switch, 3750, 2960 Series Switches.
➢ Hands on experience in SDA network (ISE, DNAC and WLC)
➢ Worked on ISE (SNS-3715-K9), DNAC (DN2-HW-APL), WLC (9800-L-F), Access points
(AIRAP1832I, C9120AXI) and Sensors (SS-300-AT) models.
➢ Configuring and managing Cisco ISR routers (ISR4451) series Routers.
➢ Configuring and Troubleshooting VLAN, VTP (Modes, Revision Number), Default VLAN,
LACP
Technical Expertise: Possess in-depth knowledge of LAN and WAN technologies, including switching, routing, and security. Experienced in IP and data network planning, with proficiency in Ciena, Huawei, and Nokia technologies
Spearheaded cybersecurity initiatives, implementing robust policies and practices to mitigate potential threats and vulnerabilities.
Declaration: -
I hereby declare that the details furnished above are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and I am responsible for their accuracy.
( S SANTHOSH)
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience: -
➢ Worked as a Network Engineering in ITC Infotech India Ltd (Bangalore) from Jul2021-Nov2023
➢ Worked as a Network Engineering in PWC (Bangalore) from Nov 2023-Dec2025
PROJECT: -1
Designation: Network Administrator
Company: ITC Infotech Jul2021-Dec2025
Project Description: -
Worked on enterprise network infrastructure and data center operations, handling routing and switching environments across DC, DR, and branch locations. Configured Cisco routers and switches, implemented VLANs, STP, and routing protocols like OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP. Monitored network performance, troubleshooted connectivity issues, and ensured high availability. Managed incidents and changes using ServiceNow while maintaining network security and uptime.
Job Responsibilities: -
Troubleshooting Routing and Switching issues.
Network connectivity troubleshooting, ping, tracer, and telnet.
Hands on Experience in Configuring CISCO Routers, Switches and access points.
Hands on session on IOS upgradation of Cisco switches and routers (CISCO 1900 series and SG 300
and 200 series).
Configure BGP, EIGRP, OSPF and other routing protocols in devices.
Configuring and maintaining Cisco, HP, Avaya L2 & L3 Switches and routers.
Configuring VLAN, STP and port-channel.
Trouble shooting Access controller and Access points in the client network
Monitor the router, switch, and firewall on day-to-day activities.
Basic knowledge and experience in the SDWAN standard edition.
Cisco switch configuration particularly VLAN configuration/troubleshooting.
Worked on incidents, Change and problem tickets with E-helpline tool and service Now.
Worked on a Privileged identity solution for network devices.
Blocking external and unwanted IPs at network level.
Working on RISK identification and reduction for client networks.
Maintaining customer’s network infrastructure as per their needs.
Maintaining Data Centre Network devices (Switches, Routers, Cisco Wi-Fi Controller, Access points,
Load balancers, DWAN) locally and remotely.
Providing network support for all the branches, HUB, DC and DR locations.
Monitoring all the network and security devices and WAN links .
Handling escalations and network security related Outages &Incidents.
Regular changes in Network devices as per the requirements.
• Hardening the devices as per requirement - Routers, Switches.
• Regular coordination with customer for network related issues.
• Responsible for maintaining 99.7% Uptime for internal as well as customer network.
Monitor the CPU and memory utilization of network devices.
Following with the vendor for Switch/Router/ISP for IT infra related issues.
Vendor follow-ups for link issues as per SLA for L2 level issues.
Maintain 100% PAC Score on Incidents, SRs & Change Calls.
Quality of Updates on the incidents & number of incidents closed.
Operating, Troubleshooting, Providing Solutions and maintaining the Data center.
Handling the Daily base allocated incident tickets / change activities with adhering SLA Targets.
Implementing and Monitoring the Core Network devices like Routers, Switches in the Datacenters.
Hands on experience in Incident management, change management, Task management, Problem
management based on ITIL process.
Working on Cisco Switches (6513 Catalyst switch, 2960, 3560, 3750 etc.) and Routers (Cisco ASR
and ISR, Cisco 4451,4431 and 3945 series Routers).
Hardening the Cisco network devices according to the IT security policy.
Coordinating with ISP for the initial link level troubleshooting on Internet links.
Analysing the utilization, top-talkers reports and providing the clients with better solutions by using
Solar winds.
Maintaining network changes through the proper change management process.
PROJECT: -2
Designation: Network Engineer
Company: PWC Nov2023-Dec2025.
Project Description: -
Worked as a Network Administrator managing enterprise network operations including configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Cisco routers and L3 switches. Experienced in routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) and switching technologies (VLAN, STP, HSRP). Provided L1–L2 support for Palo Alto and Cisco ASA firewalls. Also involved in 5G network planning, basic network automation to improve performance and efficiency.
Job Responsibilities: -
Troubleshooting, application performance, and working with TAC.
Configuration, Operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Cisco core routers and L3 switches.
Configuration of OSPF, EIGRP, BGP and static routes.
Configure VLAN, Trunk, Ether-Channels, STP, and HSRP protocols.
Troubleshoot issues with spanning tree loops and root bridge issues in the LAN.
Supported L1–L2 operations on Palo Alto and Cisco ASA firewalls, including monitoring, log analysis,
policy/NAT changes, and basic troubleshooting.
• To provide POTS/PSTN lines as a temporary replacement for those on UK 20CN switch networks.
Media Gateway is being used where Digital Voice or GNOME(Geographic Numbering over mobile)
cannot be deployed.
logical connectivity between the 7750 Edge Router and the Media Gateway Device, and updating the IP address.
Performing the graphical connectivity in the Bert Tool, Lines are connected to the MDF using existing Openreach cables from the MSAN, HDF, and CMF.
Ordering the Hydra cables through the CommScope application while maintaining a buffer length of 6 m.
BT (L2C) 5G Network Planning/Designing: Led the planning and design efforts for BT's Layer 2 Connectivity (L2C)
5G network in the Transmission Platform. Managed edge and Metro chassis upgrade to align with customer requirements and enhance network performance.
Network Automation: Demonstrated expertise in implementing network solutions using automation
techniques, enhancing operational efficiency, and reducing manual efforts.
